newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed after early rally fizzles.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed after early rally fizzles.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed mixed on Monday, as an early morning rally, sparked by August U.S. employment data on Friday, fizzled out, brokers said.
Since the rebound was frail, stock prices may be trapped in a limited range this week, they said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average closed up 49.74 points, or 0.25 percent, at 20,202.27. But its December futures lost 30 points to end at 20,230.
"The rebound was extremely slow, indicating that it is still possible for stocks to post more losses," said Harushige Kobayashi, an analyst at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
